name: Acquia Web Governance
description: Adds an on-demand "Quick Scan" to Drupal node forms and the Canvas page builder that sends the current page's rendered HTML/CSS to the Acquia Web Governance (Monsido) API and shows accessibility, SEO, readability and data-privacy findings in a modal.
project_description: Adds an Acquia Web Governance "Quick Scan" to the Drupal content-editing experience. From any node edit form (or the Canvas page builder) an editor with the 'scan acquia optimize' permission can scan the page they are editing: the module renders a preview of the node, collects its HTML and CSS in the browser, and sends that to the Acquia Web Governance (Monsido) API, which returns accessibility violations (WCAG 2.0/2.1/2.2, levels A/AA/AAA), SEO issues, a readability score and data-privacy violations. Results are shown in a staged modal (initial -> scanning -> results) and are NOT synchronised to the Acquia account. It is a per-page, on-demand scanner, not a whole-site crawler. Requires a valid Acquia Web Governance account; the API URL is restricted to *.monsido.com over HTTPS and authenticated with a Bearer API key stored in configuration. Provides a classic AJAX/jQuery modal for standard node forms and a React extension for the Canvas (Experience Builder successor) authoring environment; it conflicts with drupal/experience_builder. Configure at Administration > Configuration > Content authoring > Acquia Web Governance (/admin/config/content/acquia-optimize).
